summary: OUTFRONT Media Inc. filed an 8-K reporting its 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders held on June 3, 2026. The filing covers director elections, ratification of auditors, a non-binding advisory vote on executive compensation, and stockholder approval of an amended omnibus stock incentive plan increasing share reserves by 3.37 million shares. This is a routine annual meeting disclosure without any special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, activist campaign, restructuring, or abrupt management change. All directors were re-elected and the plan was approved. No deal terms or strategic changes are present.
